verdict.rationale: cubic offers an Analytics API and an MCP server for coding agents, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question for it. The evidence never documents issuing API keys or tokens with limited scopes. The only access control documented is role-based permissions for team members over subscription and settings, which is an adjacent control and not least-privilege API credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
